**Finding: deviation (IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)**

- **Where:** Section 7.0 Materials (p0082, p0085), plus a gap on Customer Data ownership across §§ 1, 11.6, 14.17, 14.18.
- **Problem:** Unspecified Materials default to **Type II** — IBM owns work product created for Bluefly — and the Type II licence back permits only use/reproduction/display/distribution **"within Customer's Enterprise only"**, with no right to modify, create derivative works or sublicense. That fails the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables). Separately, nothing confirms Bluefly retains ownership of its Content and Customer Components; § 11.6 only imposes responsibility.
- **No walk-away issue:** there is no assignment of Customer IP/data to IBM (Required Consents is service-delivery only) and no joint ownership.
- **Redline (validated, preferred position):** default unspecified Materials to Type I; broaden the Type II licence to modification and sublicensing for our business; add a Content/Customer Components ownership sentence — while leaving IBM's pre-existing materials and Base Components ownership untouched.
